summary: Repairs the failed 5.19.02 placement-promotion candidate and maps user-supplied lighting/effect part behavior into existing runtime stores. Adds an end-to-end trial-result -> existing store -> resolver/build-sheet runbook, routes creative lighting/effect findings into the creative index, adds provisional JSON-only buildable records for SWARM_TROPHY_G/B/R and B_SHL_D without hand-editing the verified extraction overlay, and wires part-effect findings into part_context_resolver CREATIVE_CONTEXT. Active verified part map remains the geometry anchor.
release_reason: Owner-approved part-data enrichment for lighting/effects and modded/game-file-discovered buildables, with acceptance-gate repair after 5.19.02 failed independent release verification.
